A1.justification: Both complete 46-page PDFs describe the same AC-DC denoiser and ADMM-PnP framework. Their text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–I support reliable comparison; all appendix pages match in text and rendering.

before.justification: v1 reports original image-reconstruction experiments on FFHQ and ImageNet, including baseline comparisons, ablations and diagnostic analyses in Section 6 and Appendix I.

after.justification: v3 retains these original reconstruction experiments and supplementary analyses, including the results in Tables 1, 4 and 5.

M1.justification: The three-stage denoiser, ADMM updates and Tweedie/ODE variants are unchanged. Algorithm 1 changes w^(0) and w^(J) to w^(k,0) and w^(k,J), making the existing outer-iteration index consistent without changing the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same FFHQ and ImageNet coverage: super-resolution, Gaussian/motion/nonlinear deblurring, random/box inpainting, HDR and phase retrieval. The additional perceptual-regularization example in Appendix I.3 is also retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership within each experiment is unchanged. Tables 1 and 4 and Figures 10–15 retain the same task-specific comparisons involving DPS, DAPS, DDRM, DiffPIR, RED-diff, DPIR, DCDP and PMC where evaluated.

E3.justification: Section 6, Table 3 and Appendix H retain the same validation-image sampling, measurement operators, noise settings, pretrained models, metrics and optimization settings. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The DC-step ablation in Figure 5, correction ablation in Table 5, empirical assumption checks in Appendix I.2 and decay-window/NFE analysis in Appendix I.6 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions average benchmark metrics over 100 images and report mean plus standard deviation over 100 FFHQ images in Figures 10–15. Repeated-run, seed and uncertainty-reporting information is unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results, plotted trends and qualitative reconstructions match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains Ours-tweedie's FFHQ 4× super-resolution scores of 30.439 PSNR, 0.857 SSIM and 0.178 LPIPS.

T1.justification: Section 4 and Appendices A–F retain the same definitions, assumptions, theorems, derivations and proofs, including finite-DC-step and ODE-denoiser results. Algorithm 1's index edits are notation corrections.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about manifold correction, convergence under fixed and adaptive step sizes, and reconstruction quality. The added code-availability sentence does not redefine the scientific contributions.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, experimental interpretations and limitations are unchanged. Section 7 retains the qualifications concerning nonconvex constant-step convergence, recoverability, heuristic noise schedules and score-evaluation cost.

D1.justification: v1 states that source code accompanies the supplementary material. v3 retains that statement and adds an explicit public GitHub repository location in the abstract, improving access information. Hyperparameters, implementation details and hardware disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including Section 5. The bibliography contains the same entries; some move between pages after the acknowledgment expands.

P1.justification: v3 adds the code-availability sentence, makes two Algorithm 1 indices consistent and expands the acknowledgment to include Oregon State University's SciRIS funding. The remaining narrative and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Added text slightly reflows the abstract and the reference pages following the acknowledgment. Figures and tables retain their content, design, numbering and placement.

improvement.justification: The explicit repository location improves code discoverability beyond v1's supplementary-material statement, and consistent iteration indices improve Algorithm 1's clarity. These provide a limited gain in reproducibility guidance and presentation; the scientific evidence and stated limitations remain unchanged.
